description: The numbers the Insights page shows: volume and trend, completion funnel, median time to complete, sources and surfaces, per-field breakdowns, and draft drop-off. Filter with the responses-grid grammar (range, q, source, respondent, where) and optionally segment on one field with by/op/eq to compare that slice against the whole. Withheld responses are never counted. The payload rides in an {untrusted, note, data} envelope because the per-field breakdowns quote respondent answers verbatim — which is also why this needs BOTH forms:read and responses:read on a key.

eq.description: The value to segment on when op is eq.

form.description: Form id or hosted slug. A stable push handle also resolves on a login token; a project API key takes the id or slug.

name: fillo_form_insights
title: Read a form's insights
